decision: Drop of 30 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Engine (ICE) 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE)
offence: Breaches of Article B8.2.2 (read in conjunction with B8.2.3) of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 30 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B8.2.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations. The use of each additional element in this case carries a 10 grid place penalty therefore there is an accumulation of 30 places. Subject to Car 12 being classified in the results of Qualifying, Car 12 will be allocated a grid position in the race in accordance with Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 12 Changes To Pu Elements
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
